info.name: StaffRoom PHP API Collection
info.description: Complete Postman collection for the StaffRoom teaching job marketplace API. Features 6-digit email verification code flow, string user_id identification, role-based access control (Teacher, School, Admin), and automated JWT token saving.

item.name: Health
item.description: Authenticated liveness and system health verification endpoints.

request.description: Returns status confirming the StaffRoom API service is active and responding.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Authentication endpoints including registration, 6-digit email verification, login, account deletion, and code resending.

request.description: Registers a new teacher account and dispatches a 6-digit verification code to the provided email via PHPMailer.

response.name: Success (201 Created)
Validation Error (400)

request.description: Soft-deletes the authenticated user account and blocks future logins.
Registers a new school institutional account and sends a 6-digit verification code via PHPMailer.

response.name: Success (201 Created)

request.description: Verifies the teacher's email address by checking the 6-digit code against the bcrypt hash stored in the database.

response.name: Expired Code (400)

request.description: Verifies the school's email address using the 6-digit verification code.
Authenticates a verified teacher and saves the returned JWT token to `token` and `teacherToken` collection variables automatically.

response.name: Unverified Email (403)

request.description: Authenticates a verified school account and automatically saves the returned JWT token into `token` and `schoolToken` collection variables.
Authenticates a platform administrator and saves the returned JWT token to `token` and `adminToken` collection variables automatically.
Generates and sends a fresh 6-digit verification code to the registered email address with a 10-minute expiration.

response.name: Success (200 OK)

response.name: Success (200 OK)

item.name: Applications
item.description: Teacher job application submission, applicant tracking, and recruitment status management endpoints.

request.description: Submits a teacher's job application with a customized cover letter. Requires `role: teacher` token.

response.name: Conflict (409)

request.description: Retrieves all job applications submitted by the currently authenticated teacher.

response.name: Success (200 OK)

request.description: Retrieves all teacher applications received for a specific job vacancy owned by the authenticated school.

response.name: Success (200 OK)

request.description: Updates applicant status. Allowed values: `pending`, `reviewed`, `shortlisted`, `rejected`, `hired`.
Withdraws an active application owned by the authenticated teacher.

item.name: Profiles
item.description: Endpoints for fetching and updating user profiles as well as uploading CV documents and school logos.

request.description: Retrieves the combined account details and role-specific profile information for the authenticated user.

response.name: Success (200 OK)

request.description: Updates professional teaching credentials, skills, and experience for the authenticated teacher.
Updates institutional details, location, and website information for the authenticated school.

formdata.description: Select a PDF, DOC, or DOCX resume document (Max 5MB).

request.description: Uploads a resume/CV for the authenticated teacher using `multipart/form-data` with field name `cv`.

formdata.description: Select a JPG, PNG, or WEBP institutional logo image (Max 2MB).

request.description: Uploads an institutional school logo using `multipart/form-data` with field name `logo`.
